metadata.name: razkyn
metadata.description: RAZKYN — a market-driven multiplayer extraction game on Solana.

accounts.name: secret
docs: Read only for the VRF seed (badge variants), after every pick has resolved.

accounts.name: results
docs: Delegated with the raid; committed back by end_raid.

accounts.name: settlement
docs: Base only: the `settled` flag and claim accounting.

accounts.name: reserve
docs: dUSD backing for the dTWR/dFAC/dHRB units minted at claim.

accounts.name: source_program
docs: escrow signer below (only the Delegation Program can produce it), this proves the call is
a post-commit action scheduled by this program, i.e. by end_raid. The outcome does not
depend on who called end_raid: settlement re-reads the committed, hash-checked Results.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: through the real post-commit path (skill magic-actions.md).

accounts.name: crate_permission
docs: public drop crates (they have no permission, and the TEE rejects a tx that lists a
non-delegated account as writable).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Present (and signing) only when the keeper registers a labelled BOT.

accounts.name: district
docs: v2: the district the terminal stands in (halt checks).

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity signer: proves the VRF program issued this callback for us.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: raid is not in the required status

errors.name: BadRaidKey
errors.msg: raid key is invalid or reused

errors.name: WrongRaidKey
errors.msg: signer is not the registered raid key for this slot

errors.name: VrfPending
errors.msg: a VRF request is already pending

errors.name: VrfMismatch
errors.msg: VRF callback does not match the pending request

errors.name: BadAccount
errors.msg: account does not match the expected PDA

errors.name: CrateNotOpenable
errors.msg: crate is not placed or already opened

errors.name: CrateDormant
errors.msg: crate is dormant until its district wakes

errors.name: BadProof
errors.msg: slice or Merkle proof does not match the committed day root

errors.name: NotCommitted
errors.msg: results not committed to base yet

errors.name: PicksClosed
errors.msg: picks for this pool are closed

errors.name: NotSpectator
errors.msg: session key is not a registered spectator

errors.name: AlreadyPicked
errors.msg: one choice per spectator per pick

errors.name: NoLineOfSight
errors.msg: no line of sight (cover in the way)

types.name: ClaimRecord
docs: `["claim", raid_id, slot]`, base only. Exists once claimed (idempotency). Size: 8 + 11.

types.name: Config
docs: `["config"]`, base, public. Size: 8 + 260.

fields.name: asset_mints
docs: dTWR, dFAC, dHRB (one per district).

types.name: Crate
docs: `["crate", raid_id, idx]`, TEE. idx 0..36: private (keeper) until opened, then public.
idx 36+slot: that raider's drop crate, public. Size: 8 + 71.

fields.name: units
docs: Units per asset (dTWR, dFAC, dHRB). Regular crates hold one asset; drop crates hold a
whole backpack.

fields.name: opened_units
docs: What the crate held when opened (public afterwards, for the report and THE WIRE).

fields.name: opened_by
docs: Slot that opened it (255 = nobody).

types.name: District
docs: `["district", raid_id, i]`, TEE, public. Size: 8 + 519.

fields.name: start_price
docs: Price index ×10^4 (100.0000 = 1_000_000 at raid start) in both modes.

fields.name: start_raw
docs: Live mode: raw oracle price at the first step (index = PRICE_ONE × raw / start_raw).

fields.name: history
docs: Ring of the last 60 prices (one per market step).

fields.name: awake_mask
docs: Bit per dormant crate woken in this district.

fields.name: awake
docs: District reached +2% vs start at least once: its dormant crates can be opened.

types.name: FaucetLedger
docs: `["faucet", wallet]`, base. Enforces the 100 dUSD / wallet / day cap. Size: 8 + 57.

types.name: PickBet
docs: 6 bytes, 2-aligned, no padding.

types.name: PickBook
docs: `["picks", raid_id]`, base → TEE (public). Zero-copy (too large for the 4 KB stack as Borsh).
Size: 8 + 3_208 bytes (< 10,240). Fields ordered by alignment so there is no implicit padding.

fields.name: prev_hazard
docs: Snapshot of public state at the previous resolve (to detect new cracks / knockouts).

fields.name: inited
docs: 1 once resolve_picks has taken its first public-state snapshot after the start.

types.name: Raid
docs: `["raid", raid_id]`, base → TEE, public. Size: 8 + 981 = 989 bytes (measured on devnet).

fields.name: perm_mask
docs: bit i = slot i permissions created; SECRET_PERM_BIT = RaidSecret permission created.

fields.name: leaf_count
docs: Number of Merkle leaves (Mystery mode); 0 in Live mode.

fields.name: prev_tick_slot
docs: Slot of the tick before last_tick_slot (hazard damage uses the gap).

fields.name: crates_placed
docs: Bit i = crate i placed by place_crates (all 36 required to start).

fields.name: crate_pos
docs: Public crate positions (units), written by place_crates. Contents stay private until a
crate is opened; district = idx / 12, dormant = idx % 12 >= 8. DECISIONS.md #16.

fields.name: exit_window
docs: 0 = no window open, 1..=3 = that window is open.

fields.name: open_exits
docs: Exit indices open right now (NO_EXIT when closed). Copied from RaidSecret when a
window opens, so the plan stays private until then.

fields.name: classes
docs: Class per slot (CLASS_*), chosen at join_raid.

fields.name: event_kind
docs: Active market event (EVENT_*; EVENT_NONE when none), its district and end (unix s).

fields.name: events_fired
docs: Bit i = planned event i has fired.

types.name: RaidAccount
docs: Which raid account to delegate. The escrow is not here: it never leaves the base layer.

types.name: RaidSecret
docs: `["secret", raid_id]`, TEE, private (keeper). Zero-copy. Size: 8 + 3,712.
Base-layer data is public, so nothing secret is written here until the account is on the
TEE and its permission exists (CLAUDE.md §4.4).

fields.name: seed
docs: VRF seed (32 bytes) from the authenticated callback.

fields.name: exit_plan
docs: Exit plan: window w uses exits [2w], [2w+1]; NO_EXIT when unused.

fields.name: slice_start
docs: Minute of day where the slice starts (set by verify_slice; revealed at the end).

fields.name: day_id
docs: "YYYY-MM-DD" of the mystery day (first 10 bytes; set by verify_slice).

fields.name: slice
docs: Mystery price slice: 300 steps × 3 assets, rebased ×10^4 (M3).

fields.name: events
docs: v2: market event plan, NUM_EVENTS × [kind, district, second lo, second hi] (private).

types.name: RaiderPrivate
docs: `["rprv", raid_id, slot]`, TEE, private (raid key + keeper). Size: 8 + 109.

fields.name: backpack
docs: Units per asset (dTWR, dFAC, dHRB), 6 decimals.

types.name: RaiderPublic
docs: `["rpub", raid_id, slot]`, TEE, public. Size: 8 + 21.

fields.name: exposed
docs: Position is public only while trading, after death or after extraction.

fields.name: pending_drop
docs: Died to a hazard; `drop_backpack` still has to move the backpack into the drop crate.

fields.name: backpack
docs: Backpack at the end (units per asset).

fields.name: mint_units
docs: Units minted at claim (backpack, scaled when extracted value > loot pool).

fields.name: mint_value
docs: dUSD value of mint_units at final prices (moved to the reserve as backing).

fields.name: dusd_payout
docs: dUSD paid at claim: protected slot + pro-rata leftover (+ dust for the lowest slot).

types.name: Results
docs: `["results", raid_id]`, TEE → base (committed by end_raid), public. Size: 8 + 896.

fields.name: extracted_value
docs: Σ extracted backpack value at final prices before any scaling.

fields.name: scaled
docs: true when extracted value exceeded the loot pool and backpacks were scaled.

fields.name: leftover
docs: Loot pool left after extracted payouts; shared pro rata by stake.

types.name: Settlement
docs: `["settle", raid_id]`, base only, public. The `settled` flag (finalize_raid or
settle_stuck_raid) and claim accounting. Size: 8 + 92.

fields.name: settled_via
docs: 1 = finalize_raid (Magic Action), 2 = settle_stuck_raid.

types.name: Spectator
docs: 76 bytes, 4-aligned, no padding.

fields.name: session
docs: Session key that signs picks for this wallet (scoped: it can only call place_pick on this book).

fields.name: badge
docs: 0 none; 1..=4 streak badge variant (from the raid's VRF seed).

types.name: TestFlags
docs: `["test_flags"]`, base, admin-set. Only used by devnet test 11. Size: 8 + 2.

types.name: View
docs: `["view", raid_id, slot]`, TEE, private (raid key). Size: 8 + 54.
